title: Clockwise Satellite Photo Rotation
description: An orbital satellite captures a square grid of high-resolution photographic pixels representing a terrain map. Due to an orientation error, the image needs to be rotated exactly 90 degrees clockwise in-place to align with geographical coordinates. You must perform this transformation without allocating an extra 2D matrix for the image.
input_format: An n x n 2D integer matrix representing the image pixels.
output_format: Modify the input matrix in-place to reflect a 90-degree clockwise rotation.

examples.explanation: Rotating the 2x2 grid 90 degrees clockwise moves 1 to top-right, 2 to bottom-right, 3 to top-left, and 4 to bottom-left.
The 4x4 matrix is rotated 90 degrees clockwise in-place.
A 1x1 matrix remains identical after rotation.
